pipeline/markets.mjs: self-compiled year-end closes (TAIEX, BTC/USD) cross-checked against several public sources
pipeline/markets-ext.mjs: OECD share prices (Dec level, monthly drawdown), WB Pink Sheet commodity prices, WDI rates/CPI → real annual returns per country
pipeline/markets-ext.mjs: OECD real house price index (RHP) + PaG GPRR100 (mandatory, ÷100) and CRPLF22 per sex; non-listed countries use the OECD median (推估)
pipeline/wpp-extra.mjs: WPP 2024 TFR / mean age at childbearing → per-country series; values copied

pipeline/l1.mjs: ILOSTAT EMP_TEMP by sex × occupation (ISCO-08 major groups, ISCO-88 where -08 missing), thousands → share of total employment of known occupation per (sex, major 0–9); one observation per decade anchor (nearest year ±5)
pipeline/l1.mjs: ILOSTAT EMP_NIFL informal employment rate by sex, % → proportion; one observation per decade anchor (±5 y) plus the latest year

pipeline/l1.mjs: OECD PaG (DF_PAG) latest year per measure × sex; kept only OECD pension-model outputs CRPLF22, FRPLF22, GPRR100, NPRR100 (mandatory schemes, % → proportion); dropped third-party-derived measures ATRAEP, ATRPPAE, ATRW, AWGW, CIOP, EDIOP, EIOP, ELMEA, ER, EYLME, FR, GPRR200, GPRR50, GPW100, GPW200, GPW50, LE, NPRR200, NPRR50, NPW100, NPW200, NPW50, OAIP, OAWAR, OCOP, PEP, PPEP, PTOP
pipeline/l1.mjs: UIS GER.5T8 gross tertiary enrolment ratio, % → proportion; one observation per decade anchor (±5 y). Share-alike: this file only, CC BY-SA 4.0

pipeline/l2.mjs: statutory conscription terms (months) by first service year and birth cohort, compiled by hand from the cited statutes/notices; call-up shares under lotteries, branch mix and conscript pay (share of mean wage) are design estimates flagged est (推估)
pipeline/l2.mjs: T1 wave-A institutions (school system, exams, health insurance, pensions, labour features) by start year, compiled by hand from the cited statutes; names are our own wording
